name: Input Stage
description: Receives merged canonical graph from Agent 02

name: Analysis Stage
description: Evaluates each data flow for trust boundary crossing and enriches metadata

name: Output Stage
description: Emits trust-boundary-enriched canonical graph to orchestrator

name: Graph Fetcher
description: Retrieves merged canonical graph from Agent 02 state; validates schema compliance

name: LLM Prompt Handler
description: Constructs Agent 03 system prompt (trust boundary evaluation rules) and user prompt (canonical graph with all data flows); calls LLM

name: Boundary Enricher
description: Applies trust boundary crossing decisions from LLM response; sets trust_boundary_crossing (boolean true/false) and trust_boundary_name for each data flow

name: Validation Engine
description: Validates enriched graph; ensures trust_boundary_crossing is boolean for every flow; ensures trust_boundary_name is set for crossing=true entries; rejects schema violations

name: State Emitter
description: Serializes boundary-enriched canonical graph; returns to orchestrator for Agent 04
